comments.author: @BeyondTheMapTV1
comments.text: Guyana is one of the most interesting economic stories in South America because rapid national growth does not automatically mean households feel wealthy overnight. 🇬🇾🛢 Oil can transform government revenue and infrastructure quickly, while wages, housing and inequality take much longer to change. The contrast between its new energy economy and vast rainforest also creates an unusual challenge for the country’s future.

replies.author: @UnseenWorldDocs_Us
replies.text: 💭 Exactly—low prices for tourists can hide a very different reality for local families. Do you think travel videos should show wages more often?
